name: Proteoglycan-Related Bone Disorder

criteria.description: Presence of characteristic skeletal dysplasia with short stature and abnormal bone morphology
Radiographic evidence of irregular epiphyseal ossification and metaphyseal abnormalities
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes encoding proteoglycan biosynthesis or degradation enzymes
Presence of joint hypermobility and ligamentous laxity
Positive family history consistent with autosomal recessive or dominant inheritance

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria including clinical skeletal dysplasia, radiologic findings, and genetic confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires multidisciplinary evaluation including clinical, radiological, and molecular genetic assessments.

searchTerms: irregular bone development in growth plates
bone deformities with abnormal growth areas

pathognomonic.symptomName: Short stature due to skeletal dysplasia
searchTerms: short height caused by bone growth disorders
below average stature due to skeletal issues

occasional.symptomName: Joint pain secondary to skeletal abnormalities
searchTerms: painful joints related to bone issues

occasional.symptomName: Recurrent bone fractures with minimal trauma
searchTerms: frequent broken bones from minor injuries

rare.symptomName: Respiratory complications due to thoracic cage deformities
searchTerms: respiratory issues due to thoracic abnormalities

laboratory: Elevated urinary glycosaminoglycan levels in some cases
Normal routine blood counts and metabolic panels
imaging: X-rays showing irregular epiphyseal ossification and metaphyseal dysplasia
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes involved in proteoglycan biosynthesis (e.g., B3GAT3, XYLT1)
Molecular confirmation via targeted gene panels or whole exome sequencing
other: Histological analysis of bone biopsy showing abnormal proteoglycan deposition

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of systemic organ involvement including hepatosplenomegaly
Predominantly epiphyseal involvement without metaphyseal abnormalities
Later onset and milder short stature
Absence of proteoglycan biosynthesis gene mutations

redFlags: Progressive skeletal deformities leading to functional impairment
Early onset severe short stature with abnormal bone morphology
Family history suggestive of inherited skeletal dysplasia
references: Jones KL. Smith's Recognizable Patterns of Human Malformation. 7th ed. 2020.
Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2019 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
